notes_for_editor: Thin documentary base: Lighthouse Friends carries most keeper detail (copyrighted, paraphrased). Tower height conflicts: 7.3 m (Parks Canada), 8.5 m (record), 25 ft/11.6 m (Lighthouse Friends, apparently focal height). The reports show the concrete tower started 1919 and completed in the report volume labelled 1920. Keeper years for Carpenter end (1930) and Bergen come from Lighthouse Friends only. Several marine_ca volume labels (1900-1903) may be fiscal years ending a year later; footnotes avoid dating beyond the volume label. Current characteristic Oc WR 5s and staffed status come from the record and were not confirmed from the cached List of Lights page; story does not assert them. Whether 1998 automation went ahead is not stated in sources read. Fiscal 1900 appointment page numbers matched by scan page 133 (printed). Carpenter's 1902 and 1911 listing rows were matched by position in OCR'd tables; the 1911 row was checked against the page image (printed p. 250). Henry Bergen: LF text says nineteen years from 1964, LF head keepers list says 1964-1980; roster keeps the text's span. Roster lines after Carpenter and Bergen come only from LF's head keepers list. Current staffing not confirmed; story no longer asserts it.
